description_en: Queries the basic configuration information of a specified ingest domain or streaming domain
description_zh: 查询指定推流域名或播流域名的基本配置信息
name: DescribeLiveDomainDetail

parameters.help_en: The ingest domain or streaming domain
parameters.help_zh: 直播推流域名或播流域名
parameters.name: domain_name

DomainDetail.description_en: The details of the domain configuration

Cname.description_en:
The canonical name (CNAME). A CNAME is generated for the live streaming domain. You must add a CNAME record at your DNS provider to map the live streaming domain to this CNAME.

Local DNS records are cached. After you add the CNAME record, it may take up to 10 minutes to take effect. For more information, see [FAQ about CNAME records]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/362010.html）
Cname.description_zh:
CNAME域名。为直播域名生成一个CNAME域名，需要在域名解析服务商处将直播域名CNAME解析到该域名。
由于Local DNS的解析记录存在缓存时间，因此在配置域名的CNAME解析记录之后大约会延迟10分钟才会显示CNAME解析记录配置成功。详细内容，请参见[CNAME解析常见问题]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/362010.html）

Description.description_en: The description of the domain name

DomainName.description_en: The ingest domain or streaming domain
DomainName.description_zh: 直播推流域名或播流域名

DomainStatus.description_en:
The status of the domain. Valid values:

online: enabled.

offline: disabled.

configuring: being configured
DomainStatus.description_zh:
直播域名运行状态。取值：

online：启用。
offline：停用。
configuring：配置中

GmtCreated.description_en: The time when the domain was added. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the domain was last modified. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC

LiveDomainType.description_en:
The type of the domain name. Valid values:

liveVideo: streaming domain.

liveEdge: ingest domain
LiveDomainType.description_zh:
域名业务类型。取值：

liveVideo：播流域名。
liveEdge：边缘推流域名

Region.description_en: The region where the domain name is added

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group

SSLProtocol.description_en:
Indicates whether SSL is enabled. Valid values:

on: enabled.

off: disabled
SSLProtocol.description_zh:
是否开启SSL证书。取值：

on：开启。
off：关闭

SSLPub.description_en: The public key of the certificate

Scope.description_en:
The acceleration region. Valid values:

domestic: the Chinese mainland.

overseas: regions outside the Chinese mainland.

global: global
Scope.description_zh:
加速区域。取值：

domestic：中国内地。
overseas：海外及港澳台加速。
global：全球加速
